resources.string: No notification from the screen\'s apps pops up over the map or the music
WhatsApp and other messaging apps show as an AMRI card

To get WhatsApp messages from the iPhone: install WhatsApp on this screen from the Play Store, open it and choose “Link as companion device”, then on the iPhone go to WhatsApp → Settings → Linked devices → Link a device and scan the code shown on the screen. The screen\'s Bluetooth cannot receive the iPhone\'s notifications itself.
